closure: Full author mathematical body retained. Complete classical Theorem2.1 statement and native417–452 proof are retained, together with the Vlasov-Poisson setup, interaction and norm conventions. The new square-root transport equation, decomposition of the singular interaction and the two distinct mixed-norm closures are all present. Named Lorentz Holder and Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev inequalities are standard references. Quantum stability and semiclassical conclusions are surrounding source context, not additional selected corpus claims.
current_difficulty_reason: Passing to square roots does not by itself close an L2 stability estimate for the Coulomb field. The author decomposes the singular interaction into two terms and bounds one by endpoint Lorentz control, while the other requires Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev, velocity Cauchy-Schwarz and a different spatial mixed-norm estimate. Those two source-specific closures produce the exact integrated coefficient before the routine Gronwall step, rather than treating Gronwall or the advanced equation name as the difficulty.
